identity.name: Spirit
identity.one_liner: A JDM-only dress watch with a silver-white day-date dial and exhibition caseback that earned a finish-quality reputation well above its price.

narrative.story: The SARB033 is a Japan-domestic-market dress watch built on caliber 6R15 — a hacking, hand-windable automatic with a 50-hour reserve — in a 38mm case with a silver-white dial, a day-date window, and an exhibition caseback. Seiko never sold it through official US channels, but import demand earned it the nickname 'Baby Grand Seiko' for a finishing level above its price bracket. Seiko discontinued the Spirit line, including the SARB033, around 2018.
narrative.collector_notes: Never officially imported to the US, so used examples come through gray-market dealers or Japanese auction sites; confirm the bracelet and clasp are original, since aftermarket straps show up on well-worn pieces.
